answer: A hillside meadow above a narrow ledge stays honest when every identity is tied to one plot a keeper tends in person. Each newcomer gets a patch and a lantern, and inspectors visit at unannounced, overlapping hours; only the keeper who tended that patch can answer the check. An operator spinning up fakes needs one dedicated keeper per extra identity, so 20 fakes demand 20 keepers on call at once, and one pair of hands cannot stand on twenty ledges when the lanterns are checked together. Like a shepherd watching one pasture at dusk, each added name adds a whole person to hire and keep.
